CustomField.description: THE IMMUTABLE SEVERITY. Seeded from Transaction_Task_Def__mdt.Is_Critical__c at fan-out on the four live critical items B2, F12, I7 and J4, and never overwritten by working the item. It exists because Flag__c is a single picklist that conflates severity with state by explicit business decision: completing a critical item overwrites CRITICAL with Completed, so Flag__c can only ever answer which critical items are still OPEN. Any report or metric asking how many critical items a deal has, or had, must group on THIS field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked on items the business has designated critical. Stays ticked after the item is completed, unlike the Flag column.
CustomField.label: Is Critical
